strings.scan.backendMissingBody: Place genshin-cleaner-backend.exe next to the app executable.

strings.error.title: Error
strings.delete.elevateBody: {0} file(s) could not be deleted due to insufficient permissions. Re-run the cleanup as administrator? Already deleted files are skipped automatically.

strings.unstub.confirmBody: {0} item(s), {1} will be unlocked so the launcher can re-download them.
